lesson_yaml:
schema: cairn/lesson/v0.1
id: python-mlflow-prompt-request-skips-source-validation
title: Model version source validation skipped when request is flagged as prompt
summary: 'The create-model-version handler skips all source validation whenever the request is flagged
  as a prompt. The flag is derived from client-supplied tags, so an attacker can add the prompt tag and
  supply a local path or file:// URI as the source. The registry later reads from that source, giving
  arbitrary file read on the server. Prompt requests must still reject local sources (file:// and absolute
  paths) and relative-path traversal.

  '
cwe:
- CWE-22
- CWE-73
severity: high
confidence: medium
languages:
- python
source:
  kind: fix-commit
  ref: 6e801f4259d96804c73107315b24cef0f6aa115a
  vulnerable_ref: 6e801f4259d96804c73107315b24cef0f6aa115a^
  patched_ref: 6e801f4259d96804c73107315b24cef0f6aa115a
  repository: https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow
rule:
  message: 'Source validation is only applied in the non-prompt branch. The prompt flag comes from client-controlled
    tags, so attackers can bypass source validation and point the source at local files. Validate prompt
    sources too (reject file:// and absolute paths).

    '
  patterns:
  - pattern: "$IS_PROMPT = _is_prompt_request($REQ)\n...\nif not $IS_PROMPT:\n    ...\n    _validate_source_run(...)\n"
  - pattern-not-inside: "if $IS_PROMPT:\n    ...\n    urllib.parse.urlparse(...)\n    ...\nelse:\n   \
      \ ...\n"
fix:
  guidance: 'Do not exempt prompt requests from source validation. For prompts, parse the source and reject
    file:// URIs and absolute local paths, and for sources with a URL scheme call the relative path traversal
    validator. Only the schemeless placeholder sources used internally (such as "prompt-template") should
    be accepted. Keep running the model or run source validation for non-prompt requests.

    '
  example: "is_prompt = _is_prompt_request(request_message)\nif is_prompt:\n    source = request_message.source\n\
    \    parsed = urllib.parse.urlparse(source)\n    if parsed.scheme == \"file\" or (parsed.scheme ==\
    \ \"\" and source.startswith(\"/\")):\n        raise MlflowException(\n            f\"Invalid prompt\
    \ source: '{source}'. Local source paths are not allowed for prompts.\",\n            INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE,\n\
    \        )\n    if parsed.scheme:\n        _validate_non_local_source_contains_relative_paths(source)\n\
    else:\n    if request_message.model_id:\n        _validate_source_model(request_message.source, request_message.model_id)\n\
    \    else:\n        _validate_source_run(request_message.source, request_message.run_id)\n"
